mapper.sql: select p.process_id, p.batch_id, b.batch_no, p.process_type, p.start_time, p.end_time, p.temp_control, p.operator_name, p.remarks, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time from trace_process_record p left join trace_batch b on b.batch_id = p.batch_id
mapper.select:
where p.del_flag = '0'
and p.batch_id = #{batchId}
and b.batch_no like concat('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
and p.process_type like concat('%', #{processType}, '%')
and p.operator_name like concat('%', #{operatorName}, '%')
order by p.process_id desc
select count(1) from trace_process_record where batch_id = #{batchId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into trace_process_record ( batch_id, process_type, start_time, end_time, temp_control, operator_name, remarks, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{batchId}, #{processType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{tempControl}, #{operatorName}, #{remarks}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
